'''Tikath''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tikath system/Legends|Tikath system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] with a notoriously strong defense. A group of rebel operatives traveled to the planet in pursuit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Etha Naru]].<ref name="Dice" />
